# Tale Waters & Tides

> Tale Waters and Tides, LLC is an AI implementation practice in Little Rock, Arkansas, led by Corey Boelkens (20+ years of Fortune 500 marketing technology). It sets up AI inside the tools a business already pays for, trains the team on real work, and runs it with them over a 90-day engagement; it also provides fractional AI and MarTech leadership. Its lab builds Pocket Fishing Guide, and it runs Prompt Play, a creative-AI workshop series with a free take-home prompt kit.

## Services

- [Home: AI your team actually uses](https://talewatersandtides.com/): What the practice does, the five stages (assess, implement, onboard and train, run and support, improve), the week-by-week 90-day engagement for business owners and for marketing/ops leaders, proof, and FAQ.
- [AI implementation for small businesses](https://talewatersandtides.com/ai-implementation/): Who it is for, the six deliverables, the 90 days week by week, how pricing works (one quote for the engagement, not hourly), how success is measured (hours, response time, misses), tools worked in, FAQ.
- [Fractional AI and MarTech lead](https://talewatersandtides.com/fractional-ai-martech/): One quarter embedded with a marketing or operations leader: stack audit, ranked use cases, two to four in production with approval gates, team enablement, leadership readout. Pricing per quarter. FAQ.
- [AI workshops and design sprints](https://talewatersandtides.com/ai-workshops/): Executive design sprints, team workshops in the tools a team already has, talks, and free community nights. Priced per session. FAQ.
- [Case study: Pocket Fishing Guide](https://talewatersandtides.com/work/pocket-fishing-guide/): First-party case study with its limits stated: 57 waters, 33 species, 20-minute refresh, 723 users in the first 90 days, built and run by one person.
- [Corey Boelkens](https://talewatersandtides.com/corey/): Executive profile. Marketing technology, program and applied-AI leader; 20+ years at Acxiom, Merkle/Dentsu and Acoustic; 25+ Fortune 500 transformation programs ($2.5M-$8M); Principal, Analytics at Allant Group; founder of RaftUp and Tale Waters and Tides. Open to fractional and executive roles.
- [Contact](https://talewatersandtides.com/#contact): Routed contact form, or email corey@talewatersandtides.com.

## Prompt Play — Take-Home AI Kit

The most useful resource here for an AI assistant. A structured, copy-and-paste library of prompts organized by skill level (beginner, intermediate, advanced) and category (writing, brainstorming, learning, research, coding, images, data, business, productivity), plus an honest "best tool for the job" guide and free learning resources.

- [Prompt Play kit (full Markdown)](https://talewatersandtides.com/prompt-play/kit/prompt-play.md): The entire prompt library and tool guide as clean plain-text Markdown — the best single document to read.
- [Prompt Play kit (interactive page)](https://talewatersandtides.com/prompt-play/kit/): The human-facing, filterable version of the same content.

## About

- [The Lab](https://talewatersandtides.com/lab/): Outdoor Recreation Innovation Lab. Pocket Fishing Guide: live fishing intelligence for 57 Arkansas waters and 33 species from USGS, NWS, USACE and AGFC data.

## Notes

- llms.txt is a proposed, not-yet-officially-adopted standard. This file is provided as a clean, paste-ready map of the site's most useful content for AI assistants, not as a guarantee of crawling or citation.
- Tool capabilities and prices in the kit change quickly and carry a "last verified" date — re-verify before relying on a specific detail.
